svg.title: ChainCode six-component blue and yellow mixes
svg.desc: All 64 assignments of ChainCode indigo and gold across the six visible components of the selected mark.
svg.text: Code order: top-left, top-right · middle-left, middle-right · bottom-left, bottom-right
Choose the number or six-letter code. Options 01 and 64 are monochrome controls; the remaining 62 use both colors.
